name: SMCP S.a.
summary: SMCP S.A. operates as an apparel and accessories retail company in France and internationally. The company designs, markets, and sells women's wear, men's wear, and accessories. It sells products through a network of points of sale and websites under four brands, including Sandro, Maje, Claudie Pierlot, and De Fursac. As of December 31, 2019, the company operated 1,262 points of sales. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Paris, France. SMCP S.A. is a subsidiary of European TopSoho S.à.r.l.
